description: This file contains OAuth flow utilities for Google OAuth, including PKCE generation, URL building, callback parsing, and server handling for OAuth callback.

methods.name: shouldUseManualOAuthFlow
methods.description: Determines if manual OAuth flow should be used based on remote environment or WSL2 sync status.

methods.name: generatePkce
methods.description: Generates a PKCE verifier and challenge for OAuth security.

methods.name: generateOAuthState
methods.description: Generates a random state string for OAuth flow.

methods.name: buildAuthUrl
methods.description: Constructs the OAuth authorization URL with necessary parameters.

methods.name: parseCallbackInput
methods.description: Parses the OAuth callback URL or input string to extract code and state or error.

methods.name: waitForLocalCallback
methods.description: Starts a local server to wait for OAuth callback and handles the OAuth response.
